subject: Intake: HD-FALCON-CHEST_v002_supplement on D: (8 frames, hashes verified; replaces C02-014 v004 and C04-008 v002 from v001); v003 supplement pending
body:
CFA Nova, this is an intake note for the Hon Dolo Falcon chest deliveries. Please intake the v002 supplement now. It is already on D:.

1) DELIVERED: references/From Grok/HD-FALCON-CHEST_v002_supplement/. It has 8 frames plus MANIFEST.tsv (sha256 fcfbc9d72d4ac95e4f1393c631984a5b84f41a66af1532c4e9072065b4919b99) and README.txt (4fc6b347e10e51e9c4c0a97efc6e181c41963117d608e0dd5bc660adaa24a100). It supplements HD-FALCON-CHEST_v001/ (49 frames), and that folder is unchanged. I checked the sha256 of all 10 files on D: against the MANIFEST and the box copies at about 10:25 AM ET on 2026-10-21, and they all match.
- Two frames replace v001 frames:
  - C02-014: C02-captain-portrait-014-v007.jpg (4e189d79713e5dede755db408000dfc0472a8140fa182be95ba53310fe97cb6c) replaces v001's chest-only C02-captain-portrait-014-v004.jpg (b339b3923eba2e24e2773fd49aafbe141870d1a142e4ab4fc357feb2ef8cbfa0).
  - C04-008: C04-battle-light-008-v006.jpg (dee973f45f3f1be690de356ca72d046f9bd9efb3ac72e32e30f943a6ff760b10) replaces v001's chest-only C04-battle-light-008-v002.jpg (a16f6477a70f056f9a8b2b774ca99824bbdc15b098707bb8e10f3cb698433e27).
- Six frames are new, with no v001 counterpart:
  - C04-006 v003 (b90e0f6c08a7e0cc3b5ac12aabb9e7f7a05a7938244ac78108c2ee6a3f1e278e), the chest pilot v001 held back
  - neck fixes: C41-007 v003 (a501dacf...7a), C42-007 v005 (78b7e0a8...9e), C42-009 v005 (60ea41b2...47), C67-005 v005 (62dc6b59...f7) and C76-003 v006 (ec40cb98...13)
  The full shas are in the MANIFEST.
- Not included: C41-004 and C69-012, which are waiting on Ziggy's age pick.

2) PENDING, NOT DELIVERED: a v003 supplement will follow. Do not intake any of it until that folder and its MANIFEST are on D:.
- C04-008 v007b (059641f7f275e39a8878ba68c8700a5cf2b50d234956ea4be2a712246e7e5356) supersedes v006. V_4 rated it PASS-ADVISORY.
- C04-005 v003 (b6ce2932aef7587b7bacd7ecae75abc4f0afbce2c2f6618a723c971976f1052e). V_4: PASS.
- C04-010 is in its final fix round. Until then, keep the delivered C04-battle-light-010-v005.jpg from v001. Its ship size is flagged for Ziggy.
- The passed saucer shots SB-34, SB-12 and HD-EXP-282. Exact versions and shas will be in the v003 MANIFEST.

3) STANDARDS:
- The chest standard is the twin-tower disc ship. A plain mini-saucer (a plain dome with no spires) is a multiverse Dolo, tagged SAUCER-MULTIVERSE. It is not a failed fix.
- The neck blaster is the lf_full lock pistol.
- NON-SPEC frames keep their original neck tattoo where the pistol swap doesn't apply, for example HD-EXP-280's rose ink. They are labelled NON-SPEC in their manifests and sidecars.
- No v002 frame is NON-SPEC or MULTIVERSE.

4) APPROVAL: Nothing is GOLD or approved without Ziggy's receipt. V Team, Z Team, provider and agent passes are QA passes, not approvals. Show these frames as GOLD-CANDIDATE pending Ziggy.

5) NEXT STEP FOR YOU:
- Intake the v002 supplement: recompute each frame's sha256 against its MANIFEST.tsv.
- Map the replacements: C02-014 v007 replaces v004, and C04-008 v006 replaces v002. Record the other six as new.
- Do not delete, move or overwrite any v001 file. Mark the replaced v001 rows superseded in the catalog only.
- Post a receipt when you're done.

The updated brief is NOVA-BRIEF_dedup-pass_DRAFT_v007 (sha256 40f459a8e1a1ca4f0551789d39d63d28f49e85a0344bdfc42441995443a8fe32). It is on the Grok box at /workspace/nova-briefs/, and its new section mirrors this note. C: is clear.

-- grok_chief
